sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho ko miso, singsi?
Hay, nga’ay ho! Kiso i?
Mamaan nga’ayay to, awiday singsi.
O mitiliday kiso haw?
Hay, o mitiliday kako.
O mitiliday ko mira haw?
Cowa, o singsi ko mira.
Katomireng!
Mita’ong!
Kamaro’!
Tengilen! Mitengil!
Dada somowal!
O cima kiso?
Si Panay kako.
Si Laway ko ngangan no mira haw?
Cowa, si Kolas ko ngangan no mira.
O fa’inayan kiso.
O fafahiyan kami.
O fa’inayan si Panay haw?
Cowa, o fafahiyan ko mira.
Ira ko cecay a waco no mako.
O kohetingay ko waco no mako.
Maolahay kako to miraan.
Maolahay ko mira takowanan.
Icowaay ko singsi no miso?
Ini ko singsi ako.
Icowaay ko impic no miso?
Ira itira ko impic no mako.
O maan ko nini?
O hakenang ko ninian.
Karetengay kora cokowi haw?
Hay, karetengay.
O cima kora tamdaw?
O wina ako ko mira!
Mimaanay ko tayal no mira?
O malakangkofoay ko mira.
Iraay ko tilid i kafekang no cokowi haw?
sentences.chineseText: 在桌子的上面有書本嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Iraay ko tolo a tilid i kafekang no cokowi,
sentences.chineseText: 在桌子的上面有三本書，

sentences.indigenousText: Cecay ko kahengangay, tosa ko kohetingay.
sentences.chineseText: 一本是紅色的，兩本是黑色的。

sentences.indigenousText: Nima kora kahengangay a tilid?
No singsi kora kahengangay a tilid.
sentences.chineseText: 紅色的那本書是老師的。

sentences.indigenousText: Lalima ko paro no loma’ ako.
Ira ko fofo, o wina, o wama, o fafahiyan a safa ato kako.
sentences.chineseText: 有祖（父）母、媽媽、爸爸、妹妹和我。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitilid i kongkoan kako.
Mitilid i yociing ko fafahiyan a safa ako.
sentences.chineseText: 我的妹妹也在幼稚園讀書。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho to papacem ina!
Pacelem kiso Limat, tata maranam to!
sentences.chineseText: Limat你起得真早，走吧！吃早餐了！

sentences.indigenousText: Soni to, mioraor ho kako to wadis.
Laliopen ko laway iso yo!
Hay, ina.
Pinaay ko mihecaan no miso?
Mo^tep to ko mihecaan ako.
Papinaay kamo a malikaka?
Tatosa ko kaka ako to fa’inayan, cecay ko safa ako to fafahiyan.
sentences.chineseText: 我有兩位哥哥和一位妹妹。

sentences.indigenousText: Pinaay ko mihecaan no safa iso?
^nem ko mihecaan no safa ako.
Icowaay ko loma’ no miso?
I katimol no fanaw ko loma’ no mako.
I ngata no kongkoan ko loma’ namo haw?
sentences.chineseText: 你們的家在學校附近嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, i ngata no kongkoan ko loma’ niyam,
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我們的家在學校附近，

sentences.indigenousText: mansa, rakat sanay kako a tayra i kongkoan.
sentences.chineseText: 因此，我就用走路的到學校。

sentences.indigenousText: Dongi, o nani cowaay kiso?
Nani Posongay kako.
O tatalacowa kiso ano papacem?
O tatayra i Farangaw kako ano papacem.
Toratoraw, na’onen ko rakat.
sentences.chineseText: 再見，一路上要注意慢走。

sentences.indigenousText: Makapahay ko romi’ad anini,
talatokos ko wama a mi’adop,
mifaca’ ko wina to riko’ i ’alo,
Misalama i loma’ kako ato kaka.
sentences.chineseText: 姊姊（哥哥）和我在家裡玩。

sentences.indigenousText: Masadak ko cidal to papacem,
matayal ko wina ato wama.
Dadaya, ma’araw to ko fo’is,
Ira to ko folad,
minokay to ko wina ato wama.
Ma’oraday to!
Sidinayay kiso?
Matawalay no mako mihawikid.
Icowaay ko dinay no miso?
Ini ko dinay no mako.
O maan ko cengel no to’em i kakarayan?
Kohecalay ko cengel no to’em i kakarayan.
Fangcal a nengnengen ko talakar ni Idek haw?
Hay, tadafangcal a nengnengen ko talakar ni Idek.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，彩虹看起來真美麗。

sentences.indigenousText: Soni no takora’.
Hatiya paiyoy no safa.
Soni no takinay.
Hatiya o radiw no kaka.
O rakat no tolawtolaw.
Hatiya o kero no foraforayan.
’Aloman ko widang ako.
Akawang si Kanas, amerek si Diway.
Malalok si Nikal, matoka si Fafoy.
Malacafay kami to romi’ami’ad a mitilid a misalama.
sentences.chineseText: 我們每天作伴唸書，玩耍。

sentences.indigenousText: Pasowal ko singsi tamiyanan.
Kangodoen ko malitengay.
Madadipot madadama to widang.
sentences.chineseText: 對朋友要相互照顧，相互幫忙。

sentences.indigenousText: Akaka apac a tayra i kongkoan.
Akaka pisaloya to payci.
Pahanhan to a mitilid, masadak kako a talapotal no pitilidan.
Ira ko facidol i papotal no pitilidan,
sentences.chineseText: 教室的外面有一棵麵包樹，

sentences.indigenousText: ira ko cecay a tikori’,
romadiway i kafekang no facidol.
Nga’ay ho to papacem faki!
Talacowa kiso Kacaw?
Kakeriden no wina kako paising.
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽要帶我去給醫生看。

sentences.indigenousText: Mamaanay kiso?
Malalisanay kako.
O maan a ontoan ko kaolahan iso?
O ya’kiw ko kaolahan no mako.
Naw? Mana o ya’kiw?
O sakanga’ay no tireng ako.
Mafana’ay kiso a romadiw haw?
Hay, mafana’ kako a romadiw to makapahay tengilen a radiw.
Mafana’ kiso a makero haw?
Hay, fangcal ko kero ako.
Ano hatira, tatata! Makero kita!
Pinaay ko toki hatini?
Falo ko toki hatini.
Pinaay ko toki a lomowad kiso to papacem?
^nem ko toki a lomowad kako.
Pinaay ko toki a mafoti’ kiso to dadaya?
Siwa ira ko kalitosa no toki a mafoti’ kako.
Nga’ay ho! Si Dataw kako, i loma’ay si Dongi haw?
Si Sawmah kako, awaay i loma’ ko mira, masadakay i soni.
Ha! Ano hacowa ira a minokay ko mira?
Caka pahoda kiya! Ira to ano sawni.
sentences.chineseText: 大概不用多久吧！待會兒就會回來。

sentences.indigenousText: Talacowaay kiso inacila?
Talatokos kami a miliso’ to fofoan.
O maan ko sapatala ni fofo i tamowanan?
sentences.chineseText: 祖父拿什麼來招待你們？

sentences.indigenousText: O titi no lawal, o faes ato kohaw no dongec.
sentences.chineseText: 飛鼠肉、糯米糕和黃藤心湯。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ kako miconga.
Congaen nako ko wina ako.
Makapahay ko mata no wina.
Someling ko fokes no mira.
Micelem ko cidal, to’eman to ko romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 太陽下山，天色就變暗了。

sentences.indigenousText: Mahoni to ko takora’.
Mahoni ko takora’, masadak to ko folad.
sentences.chineseText: 青蛙叫著叫著，月亮也出現了。

sentences.indigenousText: Masadak ko folad, mapalal to ko ekong.
sentences.chineseText: 月亮一出現，貓頭鷹就醒來了。

sentences.indigenousText: Macidalay anini haw?
Hay, faedet ko romi’ad anini.
Sikafongay ko wina a masadak haw?
Cowa, matawalay no mira sikafong.
Nga’ay kako misalama to ikor no lahok haw?
Akaa, ta’angayay ko ’orad i papotal.
Ano tomerep to ko ’orad i?
Hayda! Aka katawal minokay to kalafian haw!
sentences.chineseText: 好的！不要忘記晚餐時刻要回來喔！

sentences.indigenousText: O kahofocan ni fofo anini.
Pacelem lomowad misafaes kami.
O sapaterong kalahokan to fofoan.
sentences.chineseText: 中午時當作禮物送給阿嬤。

sentences.indigenousText: Nanay mahemek ko fofo sa kami.
sentences.chineseText: 希望我們能讓阿嬤高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Cima saw?
Si Sawmah aci Hongay kami.
Fawahen ho ko fawahan fofo!
O kamo ha! Ma’ilol kako tamowanan.
sentences.chineseText: 原來是你們啊！我好想念你們。

sentences.indigenousText: Da, nanay iso fofo, malipahak i kahofocan a romi’ad!
Kopiten ni fofo ko mata mitolon.
Mireko to onanay no faloco’ nira.
Nanay ka:lahad to kamo.
Nanay sa:lihaday to ko laloma’an no mita.
sentences.chineseText: 希望我們的家族一切都平安。

sentences.indigenousText: Nanay ka:sihafay to anini a mihecaan.
Pinaay ko romi’ad no cecay a lipay?
Pitoay ko romi’ad.
Sakapina no pitilidan anini?
O paaliwacan anini.
Talacowa kamo a misalama?
Talariyal micekiw kami.
Ingangolay ko nanom no ’alo i laloodan,
kaora, tiposan to pantaay.
Ano pahanhan hanhan aca mitilid kami to laloodan,
sentences.chineseText: 我們雖然夏季停止上學，

sentences.indigenousText: nikaorira, adihayay ko faliyos.
Mafaliyos anini, talakongkoan kamo haw?
sentences.chineseText: 今天颳颱風，你們要到學校嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Cowa kapitilid kami anini.
Ano hatira, aka sadak kamo i loma’ sa yo!
sentences.chineseText: 既然這樣，你們就待在家裡不要出來喔！

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, mafana’ay kami.
Farawfawan karoheman to no asiro.
sentences.chineseText: 秋天是橘子成熟的時候了。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko kangdaway, ira ko kahengangay, ira ho ko koheraay cengel i apiripirisan.
sentences.chineseText: 在山坡上，有綠有紅也有黃的顏色。

sentences.indigenousText: Talatokos sa Dawa milefis to asiro.
Cahocaho matomes to ko kadango no mira.
sentences.chineseText: 他們的腰簍才一會兒就裝滿了。

sentences.indigenousText: O masatisilay a kakonah kami,
malalokay a matayal.
O masera’ay a posak ato fao,
liliden niyam a panokay.
O malalokay a kakonah kami.
sentences.chineseText: 我們是一群勤快的螞蟻。

sentences.indigenousText: Icowaay si Sapit aci Dihal?
Ira i kacomikayan, malalifet ko mira a malalefod.
sentences.chineseText: 他們在運動場那裡比賽跑步。

sentences.indigenousText: Cima ko ka’ayaway?
Si Sapit to,
nawhani misa’icel to romi’ami’ad a minanam ko mira.
O maomahay ko wama ako.
Lalid sa misacidalan.
Maroray i omah a maomah.
sentences.chineseText: 他每天辛苦地在田裡耕作。

sentences.indigenousText: Cepa’ sa to ko riko’ nira to sinoot.
O ka kahafayan anini a mihecaan.
Lipahak sa ko wama a matawa.
Ira ko cecay a tingsa ako.
Satingsaen no mako talakongkoan to romi’ami’ad.
Toya cecay a romi’ad, i fatad no lalan.
Matatas ko tingsa no mako.
Tatodong ira ko mitaelifay a faki.
Sanga’en nira ko tingsa ako.
O maan ko pikalican talaTaypak?
O si’acefelay.
Pina a tatokian nga’ tahira?
Ma’edeng lima ko toki.
Icowaay ko hacikayay no si’acefelay ato tosiya?
sentences.chineseText: 火車和汽車哪一個比較快呢？

sentences.indigenousText: O si’acefelay ko hacikayay.
Adihay ko tosiya i lalan.
Na’onen ko rakat!
Kasarayaray a mikalic to tosiya.
Sita’ekok to a parakat to otopay.
sentences.chineseText: 騎摩托車ㄧ定要戴安全帽。

sentences.indigenousText: Makatokosay ko Taywan.
O saakawangay a tokos ko Nitakayama.
Mingataay to tokos ko niyaro’ namo haw?
Hay, mataliyok no tokos ko niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我們的部落四面環山。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko akawangay, ira ko amerekay.
sentences.chineseText: 有的比較高，有的比較矮。

sentences.indigenousText: Fakiaw! Icowaay ko niyaro’ no Farangaw?
sentences.chineseText: 叔叔呀！馬蘭部落在哪裡？

sentences.indigenousText: Ira sawali.
Pakacowaay ko lalan a tayra?
Pafesot han ko rakat tahira to.
Hakowa ko halafin?
Ma’edeng kalitosa no toki.
O maan ko paro no riyal?
Ira ko foting, afar, kalang ato cekiw.
Pinaay ko oo’ no kalang?
Faloay ko oo’ tosaay ko sakarat.
Samanay a nanomen ko riyal?
Kaheciday ko riyal.
Malalid a talariyal mifoting ko mifotingay.
Ano ta’angay to ko fali.
Ano mari’ang to ko taperik.
Awa ko talaw no mira.
Caay ka^eca katomes ko tamina to foting ato afar.
sentences.chineseText: 船上總是裝滿了魚和蝦。

sentences.indigenousText: Ina! Tahaloma’ to kako.
Hay! Ira to kiso minokay!
Macahiw kako!
Saka komaenaw kiso to manan saw?
Saka komaenaw kako to tali.
Ira i cokowi ko tali, alaen a komaen!

lessons.title: O maan a kakaenen ko kaolahan iso?

sentences.indigenousText: O maan a kakaenen ko kaolahan iso?
O hemay ari! No miso i?
O faes ko kaolahan ako, mapiri’ kako to hemay.
sentences.chineseText: 我喜歡吃麻糬，不喜歡吃飯。

sentences.indigenousText: O manan ko sapisafaes, mafana’ay kiso haw?
sentences.chineseText: 你知道麻糬是用什麼做的嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hayken! Caka fana’ kako.
Pakafana’en ako kiso, o doway ko sapisafaes.
sentences.chineseText: 我告訴你，麻糬是用糯米做的。

sentences.indigenousText: Dadada kamaro’! O maan ko kakaenen no miso aday?
Iraay ko hemay haw?
Solaling! Awaay ko hemay, o towami aca ko iraay itini.
sentences.chineseText: 抱歉！沒有飯，這裡只有麵。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay to! O towami saca.
Adayaw, paadiyam kiso haw?
Ca’to, matalaw kako komaen to acedahay.
Sowalen iraw, o maamaan a falohecian ko iraay itini i Taywan?
sentences.chineseText: 說說看，台灣有哪些水果？

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko pawli, kodafes, kowa’, kacawas adihay a makahirahira.
sentences.chineseText: 有香蕉、芭樂、木瓜、西瓜各種各樣有很多。

sentences.indigenousText: Komaenay to faloheci kiso to romi’ami’ad haw?
Caay! Caka lalid komaen to faloheci kako.
Adihayen kakomaen to faloheci, ta tanoktok ko tatirengan.
sentences.chineseText: 要多吃水果，身體才會健康。

sentences.indigenousText: Iraay ko losay no loma’ namo haw?
Iraay, ira ka’ayaw no loma’ ko nanges, ira kaikor no loma’ ko afinong ato kamoraw.
sentences.chineseText: 有的，家前有芒果，家後有椰子和柚子。

sentences.indigenousText: Siheciay to mihecahecaan kora losay namo haw?
sentences.chineseText: 你們的那些果樹每年結果實嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, nawhani malalid a macidal, saka ma:lofic ko heci.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，因為平常陽光充足，所以結實纍纍。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i pinsyang ko kacawas haw?
Iraay, o mi’acaan no wama inacila.
Tadafaedet ko romi’ad, alaen ita komaen!
sentences.chineseText: 天氣很熱，我們拿來吃吧！

sentences.indigenousText: Hayda! Ati kaenen ita.
Pacinahen to mamang ta adet a kaenen.
Ira ho ko manan faloheci i pinsyang haw?
sentences.chineseText: 冰箱裡還有其他水果嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Awaay to!
Singsi! Adadaay ko wadis ako.
Adihay ta:to ko mikaenan iso a odax haw? Mansa mangohed ko wadis iso.
sentences.chineseText: 你是不是吃太多糖果了？所以你的牙齒會蛀牙。

sentences.indigenousText: Sasamaan sa to kako saw?
Takopen a paising hatini.
Aka to macoos komaen to odax, kalalok a mioraor to wadis.
sentences.chineseText: 不要再貪吃糖果，要勤於刷牙。

sentences.indigenousText: Idahiay a wawa saan ko singsi a pahemek takowanan.
sentences.chineseText: 老師稱讚我是一個很棒的小孩。

sentences.indigenousText: Nawhani, mananaw ’ayaw no kakomaen kako.
sentences.chineseText: 因為，我在吃飯前會洗手。

sentences.indigenousText: Mihaemin to i kaysingay a kakaenen.
sentences.chineseText: 把飯碗裡的食物吃乾淨。

sentences.indigenousText: Milowalo’ mioraor to wadis maharek a komaen.
Mafana’ haca kako a patado misaasiasik mifanaw to kaysing.
sentences.chineseText: 我還會幫忙掃地和洗碗。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko titi no koko’, fita’ol, kalitang ato lokot ko sakalahok niyam anini.
sentences.chineseText: 我們今天的午餐有雞肉、蛋、四季豆和山蘇。

sentences.indigenousText: O sakalahok namo i kongkoan ko ninian haw?
sentences.chineseText: 這些是你們學校的午餐嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, o mipatalaan no kongkoan ko ninian.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，這些是學校準備的。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafecolay kamo?
Hay, mafecol ko kalahok niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我們午餐吃得很飽。

sentences.indigenousText: Matolo’ay kako ya misalama i papacem.
Madoka’ ma’irang ko toros no mako.
Sipasip han no singsi to sapaiyo a mitafo ko doka’ ako.
sentences.chineseText: 老師為我擦藥，包紮傷口。

sentences.indigenousText: Tahanini mapongo ho ko rakat no mako.
sentences.chineseText: 我到現在還一跛一跛地走路。

sentences.indigenousText: Kaorira, o mamaadah to ko doka’ ako anocila.
sentences.chineseText: 不過，幾天後我的傷口就會痊癒。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko ’a’acaen iso, wawa?
Tawki, mi’aca kako to impic ato ciwming.
sentences.chineseText: 老闆，我要買鉛筆和筆記本。

sentences.indigenousText: Pina ko ’a’acaen iso?
Cecay ko impic, cecay ko ciwming.
Lima limood ko impic, siwa limood ko ciwming.
Lima tongalen to siwa, polong mo^tep ira ko sepat a limood.
Tawki, mifalic kako toni somo’ot a payso palapayci.
sentences.chineseText: 老闆，我要把這百元鈔換成錢幣。

sentences.indigenousText: Samaanen iso a mifalic?
Falicen ako to mamo^tep a mo^tepay a limood.
Haydaw! Sa’osien ho ako,
mo^tep, tosa polo’, tolo polo’, sepat polo’, lima polo’, ^nem polo’, pito polo’, falo polo’, siwa polo’.
sentences.chineseText: 十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十。

sentences.indigenousText: Aya! Caka’edeng, cango’ot to mo^tep limood.
Nga’ayay to pafalic han kako to tosa limaay limood.
sentences.chineseText: 換兩個五元的給我也可以。

sentences.indigenousText: Pafelien no wina kako to lima polo’ a payci to pilipalipayan.
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽每個星期給我五十元。

sentences.indigenousText: Naengen ako ko tosa polo’.
O aadihay ko payso, ano mato’as to kako.
sentences.chineseText: 等我長大了，將會有很多錢。

sentences.indigenousText: Nawhani somowal ko singsi, “O nasopedan ko mamamamang sakailaaw no adihay.” saan.
sentences.chineseText: 因為老師說：「積少可以成多」。

sentences.indigenousText: So’elinay kona sowal.
Tosaay ko rinom no toki,
cecay toedaway ato cecay kamokoay.
Haliki ko rakat no toedaway, kanitosa polo’ ira ko sepat a mitaliyok to cecay romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 長針走得快，一天轉二十四圈。

sentences.indigenousText: Matayo ko rakat no kamokoay, kanitosa aca a mitaliyok to cecay romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 短針走得慢，一天只轉兩圈。

sentences.indigenousText: Caka pahanhan nano romi’ad taha lafii.
sentences.chineseText: 從白天到夜晚不曾休息。

sentences.indigenousText: Hato pakafana’ay kitanan, salimelaen ko romi’ad sanay.
sentences.chineseText: 好像在告訴我們，要愛惜時間。

sentences.indigenousText: Pafeli takowanan to faelohay a toki ko wama.
Satokien no mako to romi’ami’ad.
“Tek tek tek” sanay ko honi nira.
sentences.chineseText: 它發出「滴滴滴」這樣的聲音。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano talakongkoan to ano minokay to,
sentences.chineseText: 不論是到學校還是回家，

sentences.indigenousText: colok sa patalipaelal takowanan.
Aka siwara mido^do to toki saan.

lessons.title: O tayal no wina to cecay a romi’ad

sentences.indigenousText: Pacelem mipalal takowanan ko wina.
Tado misakaranam to, miasik, mifaca’ to riko’.
sentences.chineseText: 接著去做早餐、掃地、洗衣服。

sentences.indigenousText: Malawod ko kalahokan, mitangtang ho ko mira.
sentences.chineseText: 接近中午，她又要烹煮午餐。

sentences.indigenousText: Ikor to no lahok, maharek misolimet to kalimaamaan.
Nga’ tayra i loma’ ni fai mihatatanam mitinooy.
sentences.chineseText: 才到阿姨家裡學習織布。

sentences.indigenousText: Tahacelem sa to, dademakay ho to tayal no loma’ ko mira.
sentences.chineseText: 天色已晚了，她還在做家事。

sentences.indigenousText: Nano papacem taha lafii awa ko hanhan.
sentences.chineseText: 從早上直到晚上都沒有休息。

sentences.indigenousText: Tadamarorayay ko wina.
Ira ko mamo^tep a siri ni Kolas,
saromi’ad han no mira palesap ko siri a pakaen.
sentences.chineseText: 他讓羊群整天到處走動餵養。

sentences.indigenousText: Sa’osi han nira, wa iraay ko masidayay?
sentences.chineseText: 他數一數，看看是否有遺失的？

sentences.indigenousText: Cecay, tosa, tolo, sepat, lima, ^nem, pito, falo, siwa.
As! Mana awa ko cecay?
Halikien to a mikilim! Talacowaay to kona cecay?
sentences.chineseText: 要趕快尋找！這一隻不知道去哪裡了？

sentences.indigenousText: Ini to, misadomikoday i kaikor no ongcoy. Maxera to!
sentences.chineseText: 找到了！原來躲在大石頭的後面。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolah to lafii a masadak ko takora’.
Ka’oradan a romi’ad, salaki’ki’ sa tihelom mahoni.
sentences.chineseText: 在下雨的天氣裡，群起發出嘓嘓聲。

sentences.indigenousText: Lalid i senasenaan ato fakelokelohan a mikiloma’.
sentences.chineseText: （牠）經常在潮濕的地方和石頭堆裡棲息。

sentences.indigenousText: Milimek i rengos no sanawnawan misefeng to tataemoden.
Misangatowa ho to ngoyos ko takora’.
Caay to kafilo no likes ato fao a milaliw.
sentences.chineseText: 蚊子和昆蟲都很難逃開。

sentences.indigenousText: Salongan a nengnengen ko ’adipangpang.
sentences.chineseText: 蝴蝶看起來真柔順美麗。

sentences.indigenousText: I ka’ayaw, o nanofita’ol malafafayohay ko tireng nira.
sentences.chineseText: 在之前，牠的身體從蝶卵變成毛毛蟲。

sentences.indigenousText: Edengkini ikor no mimodac domikod sa misokiyaw.
sentences.chineseText: 經過脫皮之後蜷縮成蛹。

sentences.indigenousText: Hatini to i, sicaedong to salongan sapikpik.
sentences.chineseText: 現在呢，牠穿戴著柔順美麗的羽翼。

sentences.indigenousText: I falofaloan a misaefe’efer.
Na’onen! Tahacifek i tafongaw no falalotong.
sentences.chineseText: 小心！別掉進蜘蛛網絲裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Iti:ya ho, samsamen no lotong ko ’alem,
todohen nira koya ofang, sapipasadakaw toya ’alem,
sentences.chineseText: 牠放火燒洞穴，想要使穿山甲出來，

sentences.indigenousText: caka harateng, rengreng sa ko namal,
matodoh ko hemot no mira,
nanotiya kahengangay to ko hemot no lotong.
sentences.chineseText: 猴子的屁股從那時候就變成紅色了。

lessons.title: Mafana’ kako a caciyaw to no Amis

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ay a caciyaw to sowal no ’Amis kiso haw?
Mimingay ko kafana’an, mihatatanamay ho kako.
I cowaay a mihatatanam to sowal no ’Amis kiso?
sentences.chineseText: 你在哪裡學習阿美族話？

sentences.indigenousText: I kongkoan mihatatanam kako.
Lahoday a nanamen ko sowal no ’Amis haw?
Lahoday a nanamen! Tadakahemekan to.
Mafana’ay to kiso caciyaw to sowal no ’Amis.
O Yincomin kamo haw?
Hay, o Yincomin kami.
O Paliwan kamo haw?
Cowa, o ’Amis kami.
O ’Amis ko sa’alomanay i niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 我們部落裡的人大都是阿美族。

sentences.indigenousText: Matenak i sawalian ato satimolan no Taywan ko ’Amis.
sentences.chineseText: 阿美族分佈在台灣的東部和南端。

sentences.indigenousText: Ma:fana’ay a mikimad ko fofo.
Malalid a maro’ i lidong no kilang kako,
mitengil to pikimad no fofo.
Adihayay ko kafana’an no mira a tadafangcalay a kimad.
sentences.chineseText: 他知道許多精彩的故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Malo samaanay ko pisatapang no hekal?
O nani cowaay ko tamdaw a ira?
Ano o kalipahakan to, ano o kararoman to a kimad,
sentences.chineseText: 不論是快樂的或悲傷的故事，

sentences.indigenousText: maolah kako a mitengil maemin.
Lokoingen no mako ko mikimadan ni fofo,
sentences.chineseText: 我要把祖母（父）講的故事錄音起來，

sentences.indigenousText: mapolong kami to cafacafay a mitengil.
sentences.chineseText: 我和我的同學一起聆聽。

sentences.indigenousText: O cima ko misatapangay a misanga’ to tingwa?
I cowaay ko saakawangay a loma’?
O maan ko sasela’an no foting?
Mana sikakereng ko kakarayan?
I cowa a mikilim to caof?
I tini i tilid.
Ano malalok a mitilid i, matongal to ko fana’ no mita.
sentences.chineseText: 如果勤快讀書的話，我們的知識就會增加。

sentences.indigenousText: Nami’osiay to kiso toya kimad no fasiyaw haw?
Nami’osiay to kako, tadanga’ayay to kina tilid.
Nga’ay a pacaliwen iso kako tona tilid haw?
sentences.chineseText: 我可以向你借這本書嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Awaay ko no mako, kaorira iraay ko ni Fasaw.
Patadoen ako kiso a micaliw makena.
Awiday! Ano macaliw to i, pafeli han to kako da.
sentences.chineseText: 謝謝！如果借到的話，請你拿給我！

sentences.indigenousText: Hayda! Ka maharek a mi’osi i, patikol han to iso si Fasaw.
sentences.chineseText: 好的！不過讀完的時候，你自已還給Fasaw。

sentences.indigenousText: Malahakelong kako ato cafacafay tayra i paliwalan to tilid i nacila.
sentences.chineseText: 昨天我和同學一起到書店去。

sentences.indigenousText: Sapi’acaaw kami to citing ato no kimad a tilid.
sentences.chineseText: 我們都想買字典和故事書。

sentences.indigenousText: Hinam han, makami’aca kami to malecaday to a citing.
sentences.chineseText: 結果我們兩人各買了一本相同的字典。

sentences.indigenousText: Nikaorira ya no kimad a tilid caka lecad ko mi’acaan niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 但是我們買的故事書卻不一樣。

sentences.indigenousText: O kimad ni Antosen ko mi’acaan nira, o sakimad ni Iso ko mi’acaan ako.
sentences.chineseText: 他買的是《安徒生童話》，我買的是《伊索寓言》。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ca’eca’eca ka lecad ko mi’acaan a tilid i, kaorira tatodong sa malecad ko ’aca.
sentences.chineseText: 儘管買的書不是一樣的，但是價錢是剛好相同。

sentences.indigenousText: Minanamay kako a mitoris.
Nanay hariki a mafana’ kako.
Ano mafana’ to kako a mitoris i,
patikamien ako ko fa’inayan a kaka ako.
I Taypakay a matayal cingra, ma’ilolay kako to miraanan.
sentences.chineseText: 他在台北工作，我很想念他。

sentences.indigenousText: Masamaanay to ko ’orip nira ano hatini?
sentences.chineseText: 不知道他的生活過得怎麼樣？

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho ko miso, kaka?
Macada ko tikami iso anini, mahemekay ko faloco’ ako.
sentences.chineseText: 今天接到你的信，我心裡非常高興。

sentences.indigenousText: I nacila a folad, ya mipatelongan iso i takowananay a tolo tilid,
sentences.chineseText: 上個月，你送給我的那三本書，

sentences.indigenousText: sahetoay o kaolahan no mako.
Ano malaheci a mitilid o mamalasingsi to kiso saan ko matengilay.
sentences.chineseText: 聽說你畢業就要當老師了。

sentences.indigenousText: Misa’icel kako a mitilid.
Nanay hatira i tisowanan, malaidahiay a singsi ano cilacila.
sentences.chineseText: 希望和你一樣，將來做個優秀的老師。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitoris to patong kako to romi’ami’ad.
Tiliden ko manengnengay a tamdaw ato demak,
sentences.chineseText: 把遇到的人和事寫下來，

sentences.indigenousText: nga’ay a minanam a mitoris ano hatiraen,
sentences.chineseText: 這樣不僅可以練習寫字，

sentences.indigenousText: nga’ay haca a mapananam to sahadidiay a faloco’ ako.
Adihay ko naitiyaay a demak no mako i patong.
sentences.chineseText: 日記裡有許多我過去的事。

sentences.indigenousText: O sasalimelaen ako a minaeng koni patong.
sentences.chineseText: 我要珍惜保存這本日記。

sentences.indigenousText: Siriko’ay to kangdaway ko yofing.
Palilamay to tikami i lomaloma’an to romi’ami’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 每天到家家戶戶分送信件。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ma’orad to, ano macidal to ko romi’ad,
sentences.chineseText: 不管天氣是晴天還是下雨，

sentences.indigenousText: hacecacecay han ira ko tikami a patahira i lomaloma’an.
sentences.chineseText: 他把信件一封一封地送到每個家。

sentences.indigenousText: Macada to no kalotamdaw ko tikami, mahemekay maemin,
sentences.chineseText: 人們收到了信，都很高興，

sentences.indigenousText: malahekel ko faloco’ no yofing.
sentences.chineseText: 郵差心裡也感到很滿足。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano midateng ko fafahiyan i, mipalada’ay to fiyafiyaw.
sentences.chineseText: 如果女子去採集蔬菜，會分享給左鄰右舍。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano sitama’ ko fainayan i, mipafatisay to salawinawina.
sentences.chineseText: 如果男子去狩獵有所獲，會分享肉食給親友。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira ko mipalafangay tayni i, pasadaken no siloma’ay ko sa’aredetay a kakaenen.
sentences.chineseText: 如果有客人來拜訪時，主人家會把最美味的食物端出來。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira ko lisin no niyaro’ i,
sentences.chineseText: 如果部落裡舉行祭典時，

sentences.indigenousText: misafaes, mitokad to diyong, ato mipasadak to korah ko lomaloma’.
sentences.chineseText: 家家戶戶都會做糯米糕，殺豬以及擺出釀造的甜酒。

sentences.indigenousText: O tado^doan a pinangan no ’Amis ko ninian.
sentences.chineseText: 這是阿美族的傳統習俗。

sentences.indigenousText: Kalasowalan no malitengay “Salahengheng sa ko riyal i, o mama’orad, sakolokolo sa ko topi i, o mamacidal” sa.
sentences.chineseText: 老人常說：「海上傳來隆隆聲必降雨，鴿子啼叫不停必天晴。」

sentences.indigenousText: O tatodong no nini a sowal i,
ano matengil ko hengheng no riyal to dadaya i, caka’ca ka ’orad anocila.
sentences.chineseText: 如果傍晚聽見海上隆隆聲，那麼明天一定會下雨。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano kakolokolo sa ko topi to papacem i, caka’ca kafangcal ko romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 如果鴿子在早晨啼叫著，那麼天氣一定晴朗。

sentences.indigenousText: O nalifetan to no to’as i ’orip ko nini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是袓先從生活中累積的經驗。

sentences.indigenousText: Latek caayay ka so’elin, kaorira to hatiniay mataleday.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然不一定可靠，但是通常很靈驗。

sentences.indigenousText: Pakafana’ a misanga’ to datok ato toliloc ko singsi i tamiyanan anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天老師教我們製作口簧琴和笛子。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko datok ato toliloc?
O misanga’an no malitengay ita a tahonian, o awel ko sapisanga’.
sentences.chineseText: 它是我們祖先製作出來的樂器，是用竹子做成的。

sentences.indigenousText: Hacowa nga’ nga’ay a mihoni to datok ato toliloc?
sentences.chineseText: 什麼時侯才可以吹奏口簧琴和笛子？

sentences.indigenousText: I kato’emanan a midatok ko kapah, o sapitiyalok to foraforayan.
sentences.chineseText: 青年在夜晚吹奏口簧琴，藉以邀約年輕女孩。

sentences.indigenousText: I pipakaenan to kolong a mitoliloc ko pakarongay.
sentences.chineseText: 少年在放牛時吹奏笛子。

sentences.indigenousText: Kaorira, ano ira ko sipadesay a loma’ i, o mapaysinay ko pihoni.
sentences.chineseText: 但是，如果遇有正在服喪的家庭時，吹響是觸犯禁忌的。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko loma’, ariri, sefi, tatekasan ato pikacawan no niyaro’.
sentences.chineseText: 部落有住家、穀倉、聚會所、宣達台和瞭望台。

sentences.indigenousText: O pikilidongan to cidal, pikiadingan to ’orad ato pikidihekoan ko loma’.
sentences.chineseText: 住家是遮陽避雨和取暖的地方。

sentences.indigenousText: O pinaengan to hafay ko ariri, to sakacaaw ka kaen no kacincon.
sentences.chineseText: 穀倉是用來存放農作物的地方，以及避免老鼠偷吃。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i tenok no niyaro’ ko tatekasan, o sapilekal to masakapotay a papisaopo.
sentences.chineseText: 宣達台在部落的中央，是用來呼叫年齡階層集合。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i taliyok no niyaro’ ko pikacawan, o pidawaan to rakat no ada’.
sentences.chineseText: 瞭望台在部落的周圍，用来觀察敵人的動靜。

sentences.indigenousText: O no mita ’Amis kalitengan kasaloma’ ko nini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是我們阿美族的傳統建築。

sentences.indigenousText: O Posong ko rira ma’araway a niyaro’.
sentences.chineseText: 所看到的那個地方是台東市。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko patiyamay, yofing ato paisingan i tira.
sentences.chineseText: 在那裡有商店、郵局和醫院。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay kita a talatiyam mi’aca to maamaan,
sentences.chineseText: 我們可以到商店買東西，

sentences.indigenousText: nga’ay saca talayofing a panaeng, mitefad to payci ato patikami.
sentences.chineseText: 也可以到郵局存錢領錢和寄信。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano adada sa to i, nga’ay a tayra i paisingan paising.
sentences.chineseText: 如果生病了，可以到醫院看病。

sentences.indigenousText: O ninian a talosidan no aniniay ko sakadepoc no ’orip ita.
sentences.chineseText: 這些現代的設施讓我們的生活方便。

sentences.indigenousText: Tosa no somo’otan aca ko Pangcah i polong a tamdaw no Taywan.
sentences.chineseText: 在台灣，原住民總人口只有百分之二。

sentences.indigenousText: Maedeng iraay ho ko kalitosa a finawlan i niyaro’.
sentences.chineseText: 大約一半的族人住在部落裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Ya roma a kalitosa, i tokay sanay to a paloma’.
sentences.chineseText: 另外的一半，已經住在都市裡了。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihay ko kamaomahan i tokay, saka pasayra ko kapah ato foraforayan.
sentences.chineseText: 在都市工作機會多，所以青年男女都很嚮往。

sentences.indigenousText: Siloma’ to i tokay samira, i tira sa to a matayal.
sentences.chineseText: 他們在都市成家，也在那裡工作。

sentences.indigenousText: Mansa, saka sa’aloman sa to i tokay a malahad ko teloc no Pangcah.
sentences.chineseText: 因此，越來越多的原住民後代在都市長大。

sentences.indigenousText: Sakapito a folad no mihecahecaan, caka ’eca mikiloma’an ko niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 每年的七月，我們的部落一定會舉行豐年祭。

sentences.indigenousText: O sakakaay konian a folad, o kasa’opoan no salawinawina a romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 這是最重要的月份，是每個家族團聚的日子。

sentences.indigenousText: Mapolong i satimolan no niyaro’ romadiw misakero,
sentences.chineseText: 大家在部落廣場上唱歌跳舞，

sentences.indigenousText: mipakalemed toni kasihafay no mita anini a mihecaan.
sentences.chineseText: 來慶祝我們今年的豐收。

sentences.indigenousText: Pakahikoki naniTaypak a minokay ko polong no paro no loma’ no faki.
sentences.chineseText: 舅舅全家人從台北搭飛機回來。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko sowal no salikaka ako, “O kiloma’an no niyaro’ ko saka’ilolan niyam i Taypak.” saan.
sentences.chineseText: 我的堂兄弟姐妹們都說：「在台北我們最懷念家鄉的豐年祭。」。

sentences.indigenousText: Faloay ko romi’ad to kiloma’an no Farangaw.
sentences.chineseText: 馬蘭社的豐年祭有八天。

sentences.indigenousText: Sa’ayaw a romi’ad misahafay, milekal i taliyok no niyaro’, milikakawa to lalosidan.
sentences.chineseText: 首日叫做準備穀物日，部落周邊報訊，準備器具。

sentences.indigenousText: Sakatosa a romi’ad panemnem, tahidang to liteng misatola’, pacaedong to miromromay, mitaowak to kaetohay.
sentences.chineseText: 第二天為泉水日，迎請祖靈、祈靈，青年領導接受交付任務，飲盡蒸餾酒。

sentences.indigenousText: Sakatolo a romi’ad, pafata’an pacelem, nga’ malingad talariyal mikesi’.
sentences.chineseText: 第三天，清晨清點人數後出發到河口舉行海祭。

sentences.indigenousText: Sakasepat ato sakalima a romi’ad, saromi’ad mikesi’ i riyal, micelem micekiw mipacing ko kapah, ta palaylay minokay.
sentences.chineseText: 第四和第五天，整天在海邊進行海祭，青年潛水撈螺貝射魚，然後護衛返社。

sentences.indigenousText: Saka^nem a romi’ad misahemay, malikoda ko kapah, patayra i sefi to faes ko fafahiyan, palilam to titi.
sentences.chineseText: 第六天造飯日，青年起舞娛靈，婦女送糯米糕到聚會所，分食豬肉。

sentences.indigenousText: Sakapito romi’ad pipipay, mapolong ko finawlan maaides masakero ato malalefod, horirek panokay to liteng.
sentences.chineseText: 第七天競賽日，部落全體競爭歌舞與賽跑，完成即送靈。

sentences.indigenousText: Saikoray a romi’ad mipakelang ko kapot.
sentences.chineseText: 最後一天年齡階層進行完工祭。

sentences.indigenousText: O malaramoday han no ’Amis ko mipakayifan a tatosa.
sentences.chineseText: 阿美族把經過結婚儀式的兩人稱為夫妻。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira ko pakayifay i niyaro’, o tadademak no salawinawina.
sentences.chineseText: 部落裡如果有人結婚，是整個家族的大事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mipatala to siraw ato ’epah ko siloma’ay mipakociso to salawina.
sentences.chineseText: 當家者家裡會準備鹹豬肉和酒宴請親友。

sentences.indigenousText: Malalayap to kadang ato kowati ko mipakayifan.
sentences.chineseText: 結婚的人要交換手鐲和戒指。

sentences.indigenousText: Mipalimo’ot ho ko faki, mipalemed ko finawlan samiranan.
sentences.chineseText: 除了舅舅會加以訓勉，族人也會為他們祝福。

sentences.indigenousText: O pisawadan mitilid no niyam a romi’ad anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是我們畢業的日子。

sentences.indigenousText: Tahidangen no kongkoan ko faki no niyaro’ mipatera’ tamiyanan.
sentences.chineseText: 學校請長老為我們舉辦成年禮。

sentences.indigenousText: Papilifeten no faki no niyaro’ kami a mipana’.
Ya pakalifetay a mitiliday na patolapasan.
sentences.chineseText: 通過的學生才能戴上頭飾。

sentences.indigenousText: Palemeden no faki kami, patoor ho palimoot tamiyanan to sakalalokaw a matayal.
sentences.chineseText: 長老為我們祈福，並且勉勵我們做事要認真。

sentences.indigenousText: Yanan matengil to ko radiw,
matatootoor kami nanikongkoan a masadak, misi’ayaw to faelohay a ’orip.
sentences.chineseText: 我們一個接一個走出學校，邁向新的人生。
